sources.entry: GNU Gatekeeper - Video conferencing server for H.323 terminals.

summary.one_liner: GNU Gatekeeper is an H.323 gatekeeper server for video conferencing and VoIP networks.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes GNU Gatekeeper as a central server for IP telephony (VoIP) or video conferencing networks built on H.323 terminals. It states that it handles call routing, NAT traversal, call authorization and accounting. The README says it can be extensively configured and offers an API for applications. The README's website, support and manual fields are empty, so no further documentation links are given.
use_cases: route calls in an H.323 video conferencing network
call authorization and accounting for VoIP
integrating applications via a gatekeeper API
notable: Implements the H.323 gatekeeper role for video conferencing and VoIP
Handles call routing, NAT traversal, call authorization and accounting
caveats: README gives no install or run instructions
Website, support and manual links are empty in the README
Language and platform details are not stated in the README beyond the metadata
